pkgmetadata.longdescription: Carries the Prisma schema and the ordered SQL migration set that the LiteLLM proxy applies to its PostgreSQL database, split out of the main litellm distribution to keep that package small. It is versioned independently of litellm; litellm-1.95.0 requires exactly 0.4.81. The package is placed in sci-ml alongside sci-ml/litellm rather than in dev-python, so that the proxy and its version-locked data package stay in one category.
